title: Fourier coefficients under binary sign encoding
statement: For every natural number $n$, every real-valued function $f$ on the binary cube $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$, and every set of coordinates $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the Fourier coefficient of the function on the sign cube obtained from $f$ by binary sign encoding at $S$ equals the binary Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function on the binary cube
